biography.public: Agnath is a sword-wielding necromancer who imbues deathly magic into their heavy blows. Agnath aspires to obtain the Spellblade signature talent.

description.public: Longer and heavier than a standard longsword, the greatsword is a two-handed blade meant for powerful sweeping strikes, its length commanding both reach and awe.
A layer of vertical metal strips riveted to a backing of leather or mail, splint armor offers strong limb protection while sacrificing some flexibility.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a Critical Success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Recognize Spellcraft.name: Recognize Spellcraft
Recognize Spellcraft.description: You can interpret the arcane incantations of others to discern the nature of their spellcraft. When an enemy within 40 feet that you can see and hear begins casting a spell, you can identify its Rune if you also know that Rune.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.

Enkindle.name: Enkindle
Enkindle.description:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Armored Efficiency.name: Armored Efficiency
Armored Efficiency.description: You are trained in wearing the heaviest types of armor while still retaining mobility. You are able to use a Free Move once per turn while wearing Heavy armor.

Strong Grip.name: Strong Grip
Strong Grip.description:
Your grasp of your weaponry is firm and unyielding. While wielding a two-handed weapon that scales with Strength you may cast spells which require two hands, and attempts to Disarm you are made with +2 Banes.

Additionally, you may wield a one-handed Heavy weapon in your off-hand.

Uppercut.name: Uppercut
Uppercut.description: A two-handed weapon technique where you swing your weapon upwards, making a second Strike with the backswing of your weapon.

Uppercut.name: Uppercut
Uppercut.description: Following a basic @Action[default strike] which did not Critically Miss, you Strike the same target again with the backswing of your weapon at reduced Action cost.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Opportunistic Spellcraft.name: Opportunistic Spellcraft
Opportunistic Spellcraft.description: Your quick thinking can weave magic to exploit brief windows of opportunity. You may make a @Action[default reactiveStrike] using the Touch Gesture instead of a melee weapon attack.

Pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
Pyromancer.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Flame. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your Critical Hits which deal damage cause the @Condition[burning] condition.

The Burning effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals half the ability score your Rune of Flame scales with as Fire damage to both Health and Morale.

Rune: Storm.name: Rune: Storm
Rune: Storm.description:
The chaotic force of raw electrical energy. The Storm rune governs sources of electrical charge and discharge.

The Storm rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Electricity damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Earth.

Energize.name: Energize
Energize.description:
Your command of the Rune of Storm allows you to conduct the flow of both air and electricity, manipulating charge and aerodynamics to produce one of the following effects:

  • Instill an electromagnetic charge into a metallic object that you touch no larger than a one-foot cube, causing it to strongly adhere to other metals. Only one object can be charged in this way at a given time, casting this spell on a different object causes the prior object to lose its magnetic effect.

  • Gather a squall of wind at your current location in a six-foot radius which blows either as a gust in a single controlled direction or as a cyclone with centripetal force in all directions. Airborne effects in the immediate area are dispersed and unsecured objects with weight less than 1 are flung in the direction of the gust.

  • Produce the concussive sound of a thunderclap at a location you can see within 15 feet of your current position.

Energize may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Surgeweaver.name: Surgeweaver
Surgeweaver.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Storm. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your Critical Hits which deal damage cause the @Condition[shocked] condition.

The Shocked effect lasts for 3 Rounds, deals half the ability score your Rune of Storm scales with as Electricity damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[staggered] condition.

Spellblade.name: Spellblade
Spellblade.description:
You are an arcane warrior who can weave together Strike and Spell relying on both martial and arcane techniques in battle. The physical strikes of your weaponry partially substitute for the somatic gestures of traditional spellcraft.

While wielding a Melee weapon as your mainhand weapon, spells you cast using Gesture: Strike benefit from your weapon's damage bonus.

Immediately after performing a Strike with a melee weapon, you may cast a spell with its Action cost reduced by 1.

Gesture: Cone.name: Gesture: Cone
Gesture: Cone.description:
You focus the arcane power of a Rune into a narrow cone that projects outwards from your location.

The Cone gesture scales with Intellect and produces a 60 degree cone with a 30 foot radius originating from the spellcaster. The Cone deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Strike.name: Gesture: Strike
Gesture: Strike.description:
You empower a direct close-range attack with the arcane essence of a Rune, performing a Strike with your equipped weapon.

The Strike gesture scales using Strength and deal damage based on your used weapon but with the damage type of the incorporated Rune. This gesture does not require any free hand and has a base cost of 1 Focus in addition to the Action cost of your weapon Strike.

Ruthless Momentum.name: Ruthless Momentum
Ruthless Momentum.description: You relish the carnage you can cause in combat and continue to press the fray as each enemy falls.

Ruthless Momentum.name: Ruthless Momentum
Ruthless Momentum.condition: You incapacitate an enemy with a melee attack.
Ruthless Momentum.description: After defeating an enemy, you immediately move up to your Stride and Strike another foe that you pass next to or end your movement adjacent to.

Brutal Display.name: Brutal Display
Brutal Display.description: You go beyond simply defeating your enemies, you make an example of them. When you slay a foe, every enemy within 20 feet who can see their @Condition[dead] ally suffers damage to their Morale equal to your Strength score.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.condition: Another creature which you can see is casting a spell.
Counterspell.description:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Spell attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect; casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike
Sundering Strike.description: You know a martial technique to exploit the weakest points of an enemy's defenses, exposing them to further harm.

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike
Sundering Strike.description: You make a Strike with a Strength-scaling weapon which, if successful, applies the @Condition[exposed] condition to your target for 3 Rounds. This attack is @Rule[action.difficult] to perform and deals @Rule[action.weakened] damage.

Second Skin.name: Second Skin
Second Skin.description:
You have worn harness long enough that it no longer feels like a piece of equipment to lug around. The straps sit where they should, the load rides on your frame, and you stopped noticing the weight of your armor years ago.

Your equipped Armor counts only half its weight towards the load you can carry.

Coldwork.name: Coldwork
Coldwork.description: Years at the anvil teach a smith to read iron the way a scholar reads a page. You know where a fitting was welded, where it has been mended, and where it will give.

Coldwork.name: Coldwork
Coldwork.condition: You have a Smith's Toolkit equipped.
Coldwork.description:
You know metal by feel: where it was worked, where it has been mended, and where a single blow will part it. With a Smith's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by Smithing which you can clearly see within 30 feet, learning its Quality tier and whether it is Broken. You learn nothing of its enchantment, its affixes, or its history.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously sunder a non-magical iron or steel fitting no thicker than your thumb which you can physically touch, such as a chain link, a padlock, or a manacle, or a non-magical weapon, shield, or suit of armor in your possession which is not equipped, striking where it was welded, pinned, or tempered. Alternatively you may spend 10 minutes to sabotage such a work of iron or steel. You name the condition under which it fails; when that condition is met, the Gamemaster decides the consequences. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional Awareness check which beats your passive Smithing.

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to materials, you may forge any small work of iron or steel you are familiar with: a working copy of a non-magical key which you hold, a set of climbing spikes, a scatter of caltrops, a grapple hook. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully forge any such work outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

description.public:
A band of elegant pale blue steel that features a spiraling pattern to the metal that presents the illusion that it is perpetually spinning slowly upon its wearer's finger.

This enchanted ring grants the ability to glide laterally during a fall.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.gliding000000000]{Gliding} prefix.

This affix can be applied to any accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 suffix.

Gliding.name: Gliding
Gliding.description: Grants the Gliding action, allowing the bearer to laterally glide during a fall. The gliding distance scales with the Tier of this prefix.

gliding.name: Gliding
gliding.description:
If used while @Condition[falling], you may laterally move a number of spaces from your initial location as you glide. The gliding distance depends on the Tier of this prefix.

  • Tier 1: 1 foot per 20 feet of descent.

  • Tier 2: 2 feet per 20 feet of descent.

  • Tier 3: 4 feet per 20 feet of descent.

You take no falling damage upon landing, nor are you rendered @Condition[prone].

description.public:
This ring made of an opaque stone that has been carefully carved with graceful, sweeping layers evoking an ancient aesthetic. The ring serves as a powerful spellcasting focus for the Invested wearer.

This enchanted ring grants the ability to withdraw an additional reserve of Focus in moments of duress.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.focusing00000000]{Reserved Focus} prefix.

This affix can be applied to any accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 suffix.

Focusing.name: Focusing
Focusing.description: Grants the Replenish Focus action, allowing the bearer to restore Focus in moments of duress. The amount restored scales with the Tier of this affix.

affixFocusing.name: Replenish Focus
affixFocusing.description:
In moments of duress you can withdraw an additional reserve of Focus from this item. The amount of Focus restored depends on the Tier of this prefix.

  • Tier 1: 4 Focus

  • Tier 2: 6 Focus

  • Tier 3: 8 Focus

description.public: A leather-bound wooden kitbag containing awls, pincers, a small hammer, sharpening stones and a grinder, and a small anvil, with space set aside for storing bits of scrap metal.
A 30' length of plant-fibre rope that can be used to assist climbing or for many other purposes.
This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

description.public: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

description.public: Longer and heavier than a standard longsword, the greatsword is a two-handed blade meant for powerful sweeping strikes, its length commanding both reach and awe.
A layer of vertical metal strips riveted to a backing of leather or mail, splint armor offers strong limb protection while sacrificing some flexibility.

ancestry.name: Orcish
ancestry.description: Your birth was marked by the stars and traditions of a proud and enduring people. Your tall and well-toned body and natural propensity for toughness has origins amid a people exposed to the relentless struggle of a harsh northern clime. Your people are known for their strength and resilience above all else.

background.name: Scholar
background.description: You were always most at home in a library or classroom. Your studies focused on unravelling the mysteries of the world around you, and there are few theoretical subjects with which you are not already familiar.

Alchemist's Fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
Alchemist's Fire.description:
You hurl the @ref[item.name], dealing @Rule[action.weakened] immediate Fire damage but causing the @Condition[burning] condition to all enemies in a 4 foot radius Blast who fail to avoid the attack.

The amount of burning damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[item.name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 2 rounds

  • Standard - 3 damage for 3 rounds

  • Fine - 4 damage for 4 rounds

  • Superior - 6 damage for 5 rounds

  • Masterwork - 8 damage for 6 rounds

Anticipate Harm.name: Anticipate Harm
Anticipate Harm.condition: You are targeted by an area-of-effect attack, the source of which you can see.
Anticipate Harm.description:
You may immediately move up to 4 feet after the area-of-effect of the attack is declared. If this movement escapes the area of the attack, you are unaffected.

Playtest Notes

The avoidance of being targeted is not currently automated.

Antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
Antitoxin.description:
Consuming this @ref[item.name] is able to neutralize any @Condition[poisoned] conditions affecting the target. Stronger poisons require a stronger antitoxin to neutralize.

The category of poison negated by this @ref[item.name] depends on its quality:

  • Shoddy - Poisons dealing 3 damage or less per round

  • Standard - Poisons dealing 5 damage or less per round

  • Fine - Poisons dealing 7 damage or less per round

  • Superior - Poisons dealing 9 damage or less per round

  • Masterwork - Poisons dealing 11 damage or less per round

Arcing Bolt.name: Arcing Bolt
Arcing Bolt.description: You perform a Talisman attack against a single target. The bolt then arcs to the nearest other enemy within 10 feet of your target which has line of sight to it, striking that foe for reduced damage. The second target is chosen automatically.

Mark For Death.name: Mark For Death
Mark For Death.description:
You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a Knowledge Test about your target. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the target is Vulnerable. Your minimum Initiative during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the Initiative of your marked target.

Playtest Notes

This action is not yet automated.

Assess Resolve.name: Assess Resolve
Assess Resolve.description: You observe a creature you can see to judge whether its body or its spirit is the more resilient.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.condition: You are attacking a target with the Flanked condition.
Backstab.description: You Strike with your weapon against a @Condition[flanked] target, dealing @Rule[action.deadly] damage.

Get Behind Me.name: Get Behind Me
Get Behind Me.description:
Choose an ally adjacent to you and reposition them to be directly behind you, based on your direction of facing at the time this action is used, interposing yourself between that ally and their attackers.

This movement does not provoke a @Action[default reactiveStrike] and the protected ally gains the @Condition[guarded] condition until the start of their next turn.

biography.public: Belladonna is a cunning rogue who fights with two daggers, dealing a rapid sequence of blows against an unwary target. Belladonna aspires to obtain the Poisoner signature talent.

description.public: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.
A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.

Diversionist.name: Diversionist
Diversionist.description: You specialize in using subterfuge to distract or trick your opponent during combat.

Distract.name: Distract
Distract.description: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.description:
You dart forward nimbly, attacking with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a weapon which scales using Dexterity against a single target, with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is @Rule[action.difficult], but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke a @Action[default reactiveStrike].

Preparedness.name: Preparedness
Preparedness.description: You seem to always be prepared for the moment at hand. You may sacrifice your Free Movement for the round to instead equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points.

Sneak.name: Sneak
Sneak.description:
You move quietly and cautiously to break one opponent's awareness of your position, slipping out of their notice while they remain occupied elsewhere.

Playtest Notes

The Stealth check resolves and marks you concealed for its duration. Crucible does not yet record which creatures have lost track of you, so the Gamemaster adjudicates that: your target is treated as @Condition[unaware] of you for actions which check that condition, though the status itself is not applied and token visibility does not change. A forthcoming stealth effect will record detection for each creature individually.

Sneak.name: Sneak
Sneak.description: Target one enemy which you can see at a distance of at least 20 feet. You make a Stealth check against their Awareness. Upon a success that creature loses track of you until the start of your next turn, or until you perform an action targeting them which is not @Rule[action.subtle]. Upon a Critical Success the effect instead persists for 2 Rounds.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.description: You focus your cunning instincts on exploiting the weak points of a @Condition[flanked] target. You identify an opportunity and strike with deadly efficiency.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.condition: You are attacking a target with the Flanked condition.
Backstab.description: You Strike with your weapon against a @Condition[flanked] target, dealing @Rule[action.deadly] damage.

Perspicacity.name: Perspicacity
Perspicacity.description: You take in your surroundings without needing to stop and look. You may sacrifice your Free Movement for the Round to instead @Action[default search] without spending any Action points.

Counter Evade.name: Counter Evade
Counter Evade.description: You are practiced in evasive fighting styles which use an enemy's missed attack to devise an opening to counter-attack.

Counter Evade.name: Counter Evade
Counter Evade.condition: You Dodge an incoming melee Strike.
Counter Evade.description: When you defend against a melee attack with a Dodge, you may expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using your mainhand weapon.

Skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
Skirmisher.description: You are adept at entering and exiting the fray. When moving out of the Engagement radius of an enemy, that enemy has +2 Banes to any @Action[default reactiveStrike] against you.

Strike First.name: Strike First
Strike First.description: Shoot first, ask questions later. You gain +1 Boon on any Strike or Spell attack against an enemy whose initiative score is lower than your own.

Volatile Accelerant.name: Volatile Accelerant
Volatile Accelerant.description: A reaction already underway needs very little encouragement. It wants fuel, or air, or a conductor, and you carry everything that is needed to make acceleration happen.

Volatile Accelerant.name: Volatile Accelerant
Volatile Accelerant.condition: You must have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped in your Toolbelt.
Volatile Accelerant.description:
You throw a measure of oil, powdered metal, or biting salts onto an enemy already suffering @Condition[burning], @Condition[freezing], @Condition[corroding], or @Condition[shocked], performing a Science skill attack against their Fortitude defense.

Upon a success they sustain damage of the same type, and to the same resource, as the reaction you fed, and its remaining duration is extended by 1 Round. Upon a Critical Success the reaction also burns hotter, increasing the damage it deals each round by 1.

Playtest Notes

This action is intended to consume a unit of alchemical reagent from your inventory, offering an alternative use for the same ingredients you would otherwise craft with. That requirement is not yet implemented and awaits the design of the crafting system.

Rapid Countermeasure.name: Rapid Countermeasure
Rapid Countermeasure.description: Fire, frost, acid and the arc each obey rules, and those rules say what answers them. Any student of the sciences can recite the list. Fewer can find the right vial by touch while a companion is still burning.

Rapid Countermeasure.name: Rapid Countermeasure
Rapid Countermeasure.condition: You must have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped in your Toolbelt.
Rapid Countermeasure.description:
You smother, douse, neutralize, or earth an elemental reaction afflicting an ally you can touch. Remove one instance of @Condition[burning], @Condition[freezing], @Condition[corroding], or @Condition[shocked] from the target.

The reagents are drawn from your Toolkit and are not otherwise tracked.

Feinting Strike.name: Feinting Strike
Feinting Strike.description: A two-weapon technique which makes a feint with your primary weapon, exposing your target for an @Rule[action.offhand] attack.

Feinting Strike.name: Feinting Strike
Feinting Strike.description:
You feint with your mainhand weapon, making a Deception attack against the target's Reflex defense. You immediately make a Strike with your offhand weapon.

If your deception was successful, you gain +2 Boons to your Strike and it deals an additional +6 Damage.

Anticipate Harm.name: Anticipate Harm
Anticipate Harm.description: Your keen reflexes and acuity allow you to anticipate imminent danger and react to avoid it.

Anticipate Harm.name: Anticipate Harm
Anticipate Harm.condition: You are targeted by an area-of-effect attack, the source of which you can see.
Anticipate Harm.description:
You may immediately move up to 4 feet after the area-of-effect of the attack is declared. If this movement escapes the area of the attack, you are unaffected.

Playtest Notes

The avoidance of being targeted is not currently automated.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.description:
You specialize in bringing death the the unwary. Any Strike or Spell attack against an @Condition[unaware] target becomes @Rule[action.deadly].

An @Condition[unaware] creature hit by your attack may not alert its allies until its own turn in Combat.

Mark For Death.name: Mark For Death
Mark For Death.description:
You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a Knowledge Test about your target. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the target is Vulnerable. Your minimum Initiative during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the Initiative of your marked target.

Playtest Notes

This action is not yet automated.

Interrupting Throw.name: Interrupting Throw
Interrupting Throw.description: You are alert and prepared to use your equipped weapon to interrupt enemy spellcraft.

Interrupting Throw.name: Interrupting Throw
Interrupting Throw.condition: An enemy you can see casts a Spell which costs 3 Action or greater.
Interrupting Throw.description: When an enemy that you can see casts a Spell which costs 3 Action or greater, as a @Rule[action.reaction] you can perform a Thrown weapon attack against the caster. If your attack results in a Critical Hit the spell is interrupted and its magic is lost.

Focused Anticipation.name: Focused Anticipation
Focused Anticipation.description: Anticipation leads to decisive action. When you have the highest Initiative score for a round of combat, you gain +1 Focus.

Intellectual Superiority.name: Intellectual Superiority
Intellectual Superiority.description: It is sometimes a marvel how slowly others around you think. You gain +1 Boon on any Strike or Spell attack against an enemy lower than you in Initiative order.

Infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
Infiltrator.description:
You have mastered traditional stealth, using shadow and cover to slip the notice of watchful sentries. When you use @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.sneak00000000000 sneak] you may target up to three creatures simultaneously, resolving a separate Stealth check against the Awareness of each.

Playtest Notes

All three checks resolve, but Crucible does not yet record which creatures have lost track of you, so beating one target conceals you no differently from beating all three and the Gamemaster adjudicates the difference. A forthcoming stealth effect will record detection for each creature and treat this talent as raising how many you may evade at once.

Bloodletter.name: Bloodletter
Bloodletter.description:
Your precision with weapons which deal Slashing or Piercing damage can cause the @Condition[bleeding] condition on Critical Hits which deal damage to Health.

The @Condition[bleeding] effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals your Dexterity score as additional damage to Health.

Eldritch Bargain.name: Eldritch Bargain
Eldritch Bargain.description: There are older things than Runes, and they can lend power. When you have no Focus remaining, you may spend Morale in its place. Each point of insufficient Focus costs 10 Morale in exchange. You may still make this exchange while otherwise prevented from spending Focus, for example by the @Condition[broken] condition, although such a trade may incur Madness.

Wortcunning.name: Wortcunning
Wortcunning.description: You know what things are made of. Years at the still and the mortar have taught you to draw an essence out of a root, and to read what another hand has put into a flask.

Wortcunning.name: Wortcunning
Wortcunning.condition: You have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped.
Wortcunning.description:
Every preparation leaves its signature. With an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by alchemy which you can handle, learning its Quality tier, what it will do, and whether it has degraded past use. From residue alone, a stain, a shattered flask, a scorch on stone, you identify what was prepared there if you know its recipe.

  • Destroy. You spend 10 minutes to spoil a non-magical item created by alchemy which you can physically touch, leaving a potion inert and a bomb a dud. Alternatively, in the course of preparing such a work yourself, you may leave it appearing sound while ensuring it does nothing at all when next relied upon. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional Awareness check which beats your passive Alchemy.

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to ingredients, you may prepare any minor alchemical work you are familiar with: inks and dyes, a glue that holds under water, a perfume that lingers a full day, fireworks in three colors, acid enough to etch a name in steel. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully prepare any such work outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

description.public: A set of long thin metal pins with slightly hooked ends designed to manipulate the internal mechanisms of locks and a metal bar for applying torsion. In the right hands, these can be used to open locks just as well as any key.

A wooden box wrapped in leather containing a stone mortar and pestle, a wooden spoon, and a small collapsible iron frame and brass pot for combining ingredients above a fire.

Its real worth is what fills the rest of it: stoppered vials of clear and cloudy liquid, twists of paper holding powders, pouches of coarse salts, a stub of chalk, a sealed jar of something that smells faintly of lightning. Each is racked in its own place and labelled in a hand only its owner can read.

Carrying the kit in your Toolbelt means those reagents are at your fingertips rather than at the bottom of a pack, which is the difference between knowing the answer and being able to apply it.

This steel ring feels permanently cool to the touch and gives the sensation of weighing more than expected given its narrow band.

This enchanted ring provides a bonus to Armor defense.
