This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.reinforcement000]{Reinforcement} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Reinforcement.name: Reinforcement
Reinforcement.description: Increase Armor defense by 1 for each Tier of this suffix.

description.public:
This charm-covered necklace looks rustic, but upon close inspection you notice a delicate craft imbued within its workmanship. While holding it you feel your breaths deepen and the minor aches within your muscles dissipate.

This enchanted charm provides a bonus to Fortitude defense.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Charm with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.tenacity00000000]{Tenacity} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this charm could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Tenacity.name: Tenacity
Tenacity.description: Increase Fortitude defense by 1 per each Tier of this suffix.

description.public: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.
A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.

ancestry.name: Human
ancestry.description: Found amid countless conditions and far-flung places, you were born an ever-adaptable human. Tall or short, thin, muscular, or rotund, your physical appearance is nothing if not varied. Humans are most known for a genetic predisposition toward determination, with traditions that drive a stubborn will to survive.

background.name: Urchin
background.description: Few learn to survive the way you did. Yours was a harsh education in distrust. You learned to watch others for the telltale signs of danger or disloyalty, to avoid the attention of others, scavenging for scraps of food on the streets of some urban sprawl.

Berserker Rage.name: Berserker Rage
Berserker Rage.condition: You have suffered damage to your Health pool since your last turn in Combat.
Berserker Rage.description:
You become @Condition[enraged]. While Enraged you deal 4 additional damage on all melee attacks. You may attempt to end the effect on your own turn by succeeding on a Willpower test against a DC of 20. The effect ends automatically when Combat is concluded.

Playtest Notes

The aforementioned "Willpower test" is legacy terminology. The mechanism for ending Berserker Rage on yourself is not currently determined or automated.

Bull Rush.name: Bull Rush
Bull Rush.description: Make an Athletics Skill attack against an adjacent enemy contested by your target's Fortitude defense. On a success you may move up to your Stride directly through the enemy's space. Your enemy is knocked @Condition[prone] and may not make any @Action[default reactiveStrike] against you. On a failure your movement is blocked and your remain in your current position.

Camaraderie.name: Camaraderie
Camaraderie.description: Following a @Action[default rest], you find the common ground you share with each of your companions. You make a Society check against the Rallying Threshold of each member of your party. Upon a success they shed Madness equal to half your Wisdom, or your full Wisdom upon a Critical Success.

Caustic Phial.name: Caustic Phial
Caustic Phial.description:
You fling the @ref[item.name], dealing @Rule[action.weakened] immediate Acid damage but causing the @Condition[corroding] condition to all enemies in a 4 foot radius Blast who fail to avoid the attack.

The amount of corroding damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[item.name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 2 rounds

  • Standard - 3 damage for 3 rounds

  • Fine - 4 damage for 4 rounds

  • Superior - 6 damage for 5 rounds

  • Masterwork - 8 damage for 6 rounds

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: A ferocious two-handed swing cleaves through foes in a 120 degree arc.

Coldwork.name: Coldwork
Coldwork.condition: You have a Smith's Toolkit equipped.
Coldwork.description:
You know metal by feel: where it was worked, where it has been mended, and where a single blow will part it. With a Smith's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by Smithing which you can clearly see within 30 feet, learning its Quality tier and whether it is Broken. You learn nothing of its enchantment, its affixes, or its history.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously sunder a non-magical iron or steel fitting no thicker than your thumb which you can physically touch, such as a chain link, a padlock, or a manacle, or a non-magical weapon, shield, or suit of armor in your possession which is not equipped, striking where it was welded, pinned, or tempered. Alternatively you may spend 10 minutes to sabotage such a work of iron or steel. You name the condition under which it fails; when that condition is met, the Gamemaster decides the consequences. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional Awareness check which beats your passive Smithing.

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to materials, you may forge any small work of iron or steel you are familiar with: a working copy of a non-magical key which you hold, a set of climbing spikes, a scatter of caltrops, a grapple hook. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully forge any such work outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Combat Medicine.name: Combat Medicine
Combat Medicine.description: You rapidly treat the wounds of an ally within 4 feet. Perform a Medicine Check against the target's Healing Threshold. Your ally's Health is increased by overflow of the check.

Counter Evade.name: Counter Evade
Counter Evade.condition: You Dodge an incoming melee Strike.
Counter Evade.description: When you defend against a melee attack with a Dodge, you may expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using your mainhand weapon.

Counter Strike.name: Counter Strike
Counter Strike.condition: You Block an incoming melee Strike.
Counter Strike.description: When you defend against a melee attack with a Block you may expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using your mainhand weapon.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.condition: Another creature which you can see is casting a spell.
Counterspell.description:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Spell attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Distract.name: Distract
Distract.description: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.

Formidable Presence.name: Formidable Presence
Formidable Presence.description: You make an Intimidation skill attack against the Willpower defense of enemies within 12 feet, dealing Void damage to Morale and causing the @Condition[frightened] condition for 1 Round to those whose defense you overcome.

biography.public: Duurath is a stout dwarven defender who uses a hammer and shield to protect his allies and punish enemies by sapping their morale. Duurath aspires to obtain the Runewarden signature talent.

description.public: Built to crush plate and shatter shields, the war hammer features a heavy, blunt head mounted atop a reinforced haft, delivering ruin in the hands of those who favor power over finesse.
Named for its iron shape resembling the base of a clothes iron, the heater shield offers a balance of coverage and mobility.
Overlapping metal plates sewn or riveted onto a leather or cloth backing, scale mail resembles the hide of a dragon and protects well against cuts and stabs—though it's noisy and inflexible.

Armored Efficiency.name: Armored Efficiency
Armored Efficiency.description: You are trained in wearing the heaviest types of armor while still retaining mobility. You are able to use a Free Move once per turn while wearing Heavy armor.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: You are practiced at fighting with shield, using it to slam into and unbalance your foes.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: Following a basic @Action[default strike] with your mainhand weapon, you Strike with your shield, causing the @Condition[staggered] condition for 1 Round.

Intimidator.name: Intimidator
Intimidator.description: You specialize in exerting your intimidating presence to break the morale of your foes.

Intimidate.name: Intimidate
Intimidate.description: You physically intimidate an enemy that is within your engagement range, performing an Intimidation Skill attack against your target's passive Intimidation defense. On a success, they sustain Void damage to their Morale.

Heavy Strike.name: Heavy Strike
Heavy Strike.description: You know how to use a heavy weapon to deliver punishing blows, putting your entire strength behind every swing.

Heavy Strike.name: Heavy Strike
Heavy Strike.description: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is @Rule[action.empowered] to deliver additional damage.

Bulwark.name: Bulwark
Bulwark.description:
You have expertise in using a Shield to defend yourself and others.

Once per turn while you have a Shield equipped, the Action cost of using the @Action[default defend] action is reduced by 1.

Inspire Heroism.name: Inspire Heroism
Inspire Heroism.description: Your courageous presence inspires your nearby allies to strike with confidence.

Inspire Heroism.name: Inspire Heroism
Inspire Heroism.description: Each ally, excluding yourself, within 10 feet gains +1 Boon to actions performed until the end of their next turn.

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using Presence, targets Physical defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.

Propel.name: Propel
Propel.description:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect; casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Iramancer.name: Iramancer
Iramancer.description: Your feats of arcana are fueled by anger. While @Condition[enraged] you may still spend Focus and you deal 2 additional damage to all Spell attacks.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry
Rallying Cry.description: Your presence as a battlefield leader hardens the resolve of your allies, enabling them to sustain their morale in even the most harrowing of circumstances.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry
Rallying Cry.description: You produce a courageous bellow that inspires allies within 12 feet of you to remain stalwart in the face of peril. You make an Intimidation check against the Rallying Threshold of each ally. Upon a success, they become @Condition[resolute] for 3 Rounds. Upon a Critical Success, they also recover an amount of Morale equal to your Presence score.

Mental Fortress.name: Mental Fortress
Mental Fortress.description: Your strong will makes you exceedingly difficult to influence. You gain +1 to your Willpower defense and +5 Resistance to Psychic damage.

Dread Lord.name: Dread Lord
Dread Lord.description: You exude a terrible presence on the battlefield which tests the morale of nearby enemies that behold you, breaking the resolve of the weak-willed.

Formidable Presence.name: Formidable Presence
Formidable Presence.description: You make an Intimidation skill attack against the Willpower defense of enemies within 12 feet, dealing Void damage to Morale and causing the @Condition[frightened] condition for 1 Round to those whose defense you overcome.

Rout.name: Rout
Rout.description: You understand that panic can be contagious, you just have to cause it. When you cause a foe to become @Condition[broken] or @Condition[insane], every enemy within 10 feet who can see that creature suffers damage to their Morale equal to your Presence.

Testudo.name: Testudo
Testudo.description: You are highly skilled in using shields to adopt a defensive posture. You gain double the benefit of the @Condition[guarded] condition against Weapon Attacks while wielding a shield.

Gesture: Ward.name: Gesture: Ward
Gesture: Ward.description:
You shape the arcane power of a Rune into a protective barrier used to shield yourself from harm.

The Ward gesture scales using Toughness and provides +6 Resistance against the damage type of the Rune used in the spell. This resistance lasts for 1 Round and you may only have a single Ward at a time. Casting another spell using the Ward gesture replaces your prior Ward. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Shield Ward.name: Shield Ward
Shield Ward.description: You have mastered a specialized technique to incorporate a physical shield into the Ward gesture. You may ignore the free-hand requirement for spells using the Ward gesture while you have a Shield equipped.

Counter Strike.name: Counter Strike
Counter Strike.description: You are trained to transition between defending with your shield and a swift counter-attack.

Counter Strike.name: Counter Strike
Counter Strike.condition: You Block an incoming melee Strike.
Counter Strike.description: When you defend against a melee attack with a Block you may expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using your mainhand weapon.

Armored Shell.name: Armored Shell
Armored Shell.description:
You are expert in using your armor in combination with your shield to create a defensive shell.

When you have the @Condition[guarded] condition and have a Heavy Shield equipped, your base Armor defense is reduced by half but your Block defense increases by a corresponding amount.

Impenetrable Guard.name: Impenetrable Guard
Impenetrable Guard.description: Your defenses frustrate attackers who struggle to find a gap in your guard. When an enemy's Strike against you results in a Block or Glancing Blow, that enemy suffers +1 Bane on their next Strike against you.

Thick Skin.name: Thick Skin
Thick Skin.description: Your physical toughness makes you more resistant to harm. You gain +2 Resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

Bastion.name: Bastion
Bastion.description:
You have mastered the art of the defensive stand, becoming an unbreakable wall. While you have the @Condition[guarded] condition, you have the following benefits:

  • You cannot be moved against your will or knocked @Condition[prone].

  • Your space cannot be crossed by enemies, even when using abilities that would normally move through a creature.

  • Your Engagement increases by +1, holding more foes at bay.

  • Your Reflex defense is treated as the sum of your Armor and Block defenses, if greater, as you endure attacks rather than avoiding them. An attack against your Reflex which you resist is treated as having been defended by Block.

Get Behind Me.name: Get Behind Me
Get Behind Me.description:
Choose an ally adjacent to you and reposition them to be directly behind you, based on your direction of facing at the time this action is used, interposing yourself between that ally and their attackers.

This movement does not provoke a @Action[default reactiveStrike] and the protected ally gains the @Condition[guarded] condition until the start of their next turn.

description.public:
This elegant ornamented ring feels slightly slick and difficult to grasp. While held it vibrates almost imperceptibly.

This enchanted ring provides a bonus to Dodge defense.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.evasion000000000]{Evasion} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: Increase Dodge defense by 1 for each Tier of this suffix.

description.public: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

description.public: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.description:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

description.public: A slightly curved bar of strong metal featuring a hook with a flattened head on one end. Used to apply leverage, prying one object loose of another.
Built to crush plate and shatter shields, the war hammer features a heavy, blunt head mounted atop a reinforced haft, delivering ruin in the hands of those who favor power over finesse.
Named for its iron shape resembling the base of a clothes iron, the heater shield offers a balance of coverage and mobility.
Overlapping metal plates sewn or riveted onto a leather or cloth backing, scale mail resembles the hide of a dragon and protects well against cuts and stabs—though it's noisy and inflexible.

ancestry.name: Dwarven
ancestry.description: Like your parents before you, you were born with the enduring fortitude of the Dwarves. Your stout stature and burly physical appearance are the hallmarks of a people born of earth and stone. A legacy of physical resilience is yours to inherit, for in your breast beats a heart of stone.

background.name: Soldier
background.description: You were a rank-and-file member of a military organization of some variety. Discipline made you a survivor and emphasized the importance of demonstrating strength and dominance over others, and years on horseback or marching taught you how to handle all manner of terrain.

biography.public: Eliorwen is a nimble skirmisher who uses archery and spellcraft to suppress and eliminates foes from a tremendous distnace. Eliorwen aspires to obtain the Arcane Archer signature talent.

description.public: With its wide, curved blade and deadly arc, the scimitar dances through battle, its edge carving through foes in sweeping, elegant strikes.
A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.
Compact and quick to draw, the shortbow excels in rapid, close-quarters archery and skirmishes, favored by scouts, hunters, and swift-footed raiders.

Quick Draw.name: Quick Draw
Quick Draw.description: You have a basic education in archery and other projectile weaponry.

Quick Draw.name: Quick Draw
Quick Draw.description: You can loose a shot under pressure, although with decreased accuracy. You perform a Strike that is @Rule[action.difficult], but has a reduced Action cost.

Rune: Earth.name: Rune: Earth
Rune: Earth.description:
The orderly force of elemental earth, responsible for physical matter. The Earth rune governs minerals, metals, soils, and other physical compounds.

The Earth rune scales using Wisdom, targets Reflex, and deals Acid damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Storm.

Mould.name: Mould
Mould.description:
Your command of the Rune of Earth allows you to manipulate raw forces of rock, mineral, and soil in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Quickly shape up to one cubic foot of available material into a simple geometric form like a cuboid, ellipsoid, or polyhedron.

  • Precisely copy the physical shape of a held object that is smaller than a 6-inch cube, reproducing it from available clay, stone, or metal. The replica retains no useful properties except for its physical form.

  • Separate and collect earthen particles from the surface of an object, creature, or liquid that you touch, rendering the subject completely cleaned or purified in moments.

Mould may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Preparedness.name: Preparedness
Preparedness.description: You seem to always be prepared for the moment at hand. You may sacrifice your Free Movement for the round to instead equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points.

Mark Prey.name: Mark Prey
Mark Prey.description: You fire a special shot which deals no damage, but explodes in luminous powder clearly marking your target.

Mark Prey.name: Mark Prey
Mark Prey.description: You Strike using a special shot. If your attack is successful the target is @Condition[exposed] for the next 3 Rounds.

Weak Points.name: Weak Points
Weak Points.description: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is @Condition[unaware], @Condition[flanked], or @Condition[exposed] using a weapon which scales with Dexterity, you gain +2 damage to any Strike.

Tumble Through.name: Tumble Through
Tumble Through.description: You can use your athleticism in dangerous situations to escape harm or bypass enemy combatants.

Tumble.name: Tumble
Tumble.description:
Make a Athletics Skill attack against an adjacent enemy contested by your target's Reflex defense.

On a success you may move up to twice your Stride, including the ability to pass through your target enemy's space, without provoking any @Action[default reactiveStrike].

On a failure your movement is blocked and your remain in your current position.

Evasive Shot.name: Evasive Shot
Evasive Shot.description: You are an expert at firing shots with ranged weaponry while evading enemy attacks.

Evasive Shot.name: Evasive Shot
Evasive Shot.description: After performing a ranged weapon attack, you may move up to half your Stride for free.

Fan of Arrows.name: Fan of Arrows
Fan of Arrows.description: This @Rule[action.difficult] ranged weaponry technique allows you to fire a multiple shots with your weapon in a sweeping cone, each targeting a different enemy in the area of effect.

Fan of Arrows.name: Fan of Arrows
Fan of Arrows.description: You fire multiple projectiles from your ranged weapon in an arc, striking all enemy targets within a 40 foot cone.

Arcane Archer.name: Arcane Archer
Arcane Archer.description:
Your skill with archery can shape your spellcraft, partially substituting for the somatic gestures of traditional spellcasting.

While using a Projectile weapon as your mainhand weapon, you ignore the free-hand requirement for casting spells using the Arrow gesture and the range of those spells becomes your weapon range.

Immediately after performing a Strike with a projectile weapon, you may cast a spell with its Action cost reduced by 1.

Rune: Frost.name: Rune: Frost
Rune: Frost.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.

Condense.name: Condense
Condense.description:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Forensic Reconstruction.name: Forensic Reconstruction
Forensic Reconstruction.description: You treat a room as a body of evidence. Dust disturbed and dust undisturbed, the angle of a dropped object, a scuff running the wrong way, the one thing that ought to be here and is not: you assemble such facts into an account of what happened.

Reconstruct.name: Reconstruct
Reconstruct.description:
Name aloud a theory of what happened in this place. If the Gamemaster judges that the place could bear your theory out or contradict it, perform an Awareness check against DC 14.

  • +2 Boons if your theory follows from evidence you have already gathered.

  • +2 Banes if it is conjecture, or if the place has been cleaned, trampled, or reoccupied since.

Upon a Success you deduce one true thing bearing upon your theory, which may support or refute it. Upon a Critical Success you deduce a second, which the Gamemaster may draw from what your theory did not think to ask.

A theory may only be investigated once. A failed investigation does not mean the theory is incorrect, only that no corroborating evidence was found.

The place answers in physical fact alone: it never names a culprit, a motive, or a word that was spoken.

Undaunted.name: Undaunted
Undaunted.description: Despair takes your voice and your courage, but never your command of the arcane. You may continue to spend Focus even while you are @Condition[broken].

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.

Enkindle.name: Enkindle
Enkindle.description:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Rimecaller.name: Rimecaller
Rimecaller.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Frost. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your Critical Hits which deal damage cause the @Condition[freezing] condition.

The Freezing effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half the ability score your Rune of Frost scales with as Frost damage to Health, and applies the @Condition[slowed] condition.

Inexorable Flame.name: Inexorable Flame
Inexorable Flame.description: You recognize that fire can spread with inevitable and unstoppable purpose. Your usage of the Rune of Flame scales with Wisdom instead of Intellect.

Combat Medicine.name: Combat Medicine
Combat Medicine.description: Your knowledge and skill in Medicine covers the rapid triage, diagnosis, and treatment of wounds.

Combat Medicine.name: Combat Medicine
Combat Medicine.description: You rapidly treat the wounds of an ally within 4 feet. Perform a Medicine Check against the target's Healing Threshold. Your ally's Health is increased by overflow of the check.

Fletcher's Mending.name: Fletcher's Mending
Fletcher's Mending.description:
You have straightened enough warped staves and rebuilt enough ruined shafts to know that wood asks only to be given back its line.

The repairs you make using the Fletching trade benefit from Expert Repair:

  • You may attempt such repairs without a workbench, though attempts made without one are @Rule[action.difficult].

  • A repair you succeed at never costs the item a Quality tier.

Playtest Notes

Repair is not yet automated. The rules it follows are described in the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.repair0000000000]{Repair} journal.

Thread the Needle.name: Thread the Needle
Thread the Needle.description: You concentrate to fire a shot into the swirl of melee. This attack benefits from Flanking as if it were a melee attack.

Thread the Needle.name: Thread the Needle
Thread the Needle.description: You fire a precise shot into melee combat, targeting an enemy which is engaged by one of your allies.

Skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
Skirmisher.description: You are adept at entering and exiting the fray. When moving out of the Engagement radius of an enemy, that enemy has +2 Banes to any @Action[default reactiveStrike] against you.

Dustbinder.name: Dustbinder
Dustbinder.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Earth. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your Critical Hits which deal damage cause the @Condition[corroding] condition.

The Corroding effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals half the ability score your Rune of Earth scales with as Acid damage to Health each Round.

description.public:
This brightly colored necklace holds a stone amulet that glows with a rune that crackles faintly with electrical resonance. While holding it you have the surreal sensation of the world around you slowing down ever so slightly.

This enchanted amulet provides a bonus to Reflex defense.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Amulet with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.nimbleness000000]{Nimbleness} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this amulet could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Nimbleness.name: Nimbleness
Nimbleness.description: Increase Reflex defense by 1 for each Tier of this suffix.

description.public:
This ring made of an opaque stone that has been carefully carved with graceful, sweeping layers evoking an ancient aesthetic. The ring serves as a powerful spellcasting focus for the Invested wearer.

This enchanted ring grants the ability to withdraw an additional reserve of Focus in moments of duress.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.focusing00000000]{Reserved Focus} prefix.

This affix can be applied to any accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 suffix.

Focusing.name: Focusing
Focusing.description: Grants the Replenish Focus action, allowing the bearer to restore Focus in moments of duress. The amount restored scales with the Tier of this affix.

affixFocusing.name: Replenish Focus
affixFocusing.description:
In moments of duress you can withdraw an additional reserve of Focus from this item. The amount of Focus restored depends on the Tier of this prefix.

  • Tier 1: 4 Focus

  • Tier 2: 6 Focus

  • Tier 3: 8 Focus

description.public: A leather-bound quiver with sealable end, containing a mountable vice, spoke shave, brushes and a small spinner for winding braided string. If unlatched it unfolds into a mat that can serve as a flat work surface.
A leather-bound wooden kitbag. Contains bandages, a bottle of alchemical spirits, needle and thread, and a variety of minor herbs and compounds used in the treatment of common illnesses and injuries.
This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

description.public: With its wide, curved blade and deadly arc, the scimitar dances through battle, its edge carving through foes in sweeping, elegant strikes.
A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.
Compact and quick to draw, the shortbow excels in rapid, close-quarters archery and skirmishes, favored by scouts, hunters, and swift-footed raiders.

ancestry.name: Elvish
ancestry.description: Graceful in movement and swift in thought, you were born a long-lived elf. Your slight and nimble frame and sculpted features are the inherited traits of a people for whom elegance is a way of life. Your predisposition toward quick-thinking and precise movement the evolutionary results of hundreds of years of tradition.

background.name: Wanderer
background.description: Yours has been an itinerant life. You enjoy nothing more than the feeling of a cart or mount below you, watching some foreign sky slowly pass above you. You learned to pay careful attention to your surroundings and their needs, to tend the creatures on which you rely, and to make do with what you can find.

Evasive Shot.name: Evasive Shot
Evasive Shot.description: After performing a ranged weapon attack, you may move up to half your Stride for free.

Executioner's Strike.name: Executioner's Strike
Executioner's Strike.description: You deliver a Strike with a two-handed weapon. If your attack is successful and your opponent is under half their maximum Health, the strike is @Rule[action.deadly], and the opponent suffers the @Condition[bleeding] condition for 3 Rounds, taking additional damage each round equal to your Strength score.

Fan of Arrows.name: Fan of Arrows
Fan of Arrows.description: You fire multiple projectiles from your ranged weapon in an arc, striking all enemy targets within a 40 foot cone.

Feinting Strike.name: Feinting Strike
Feinting Strike.description:
You feint with your mainhand weapon, making a Deception attack against the target's Reflex defense. You immediately make a Strike with your offhand weapon.

If your deception was successful, you gain +2 Boons to your Strike and it deals an additional +6 Damage.

Ferocious Leap.name: Ferocious Leap
Ferocious Leap.description: You Jump up to 10 feet, delivering a Strike against an enemy within melee range of where you land. Your movement ignores difficult terrain and is not blocked by enemy creatures.

biography.public: Fizzit is a clever spellcrafter and scholar who slings spells from a distance and seeks to harness elemental forces to work in their service. Fizzit aspires to obtain the Conjurer signature talent.

description.public: Ring mail features metal rings sewn onto a padded base, offering a compromise of less protection than heavier mail options in exchange for greater mobility.

A sphere of crystal or glass that — in the palm of a capable spellcaster — becomes a conduit for their power. It gathers voltaic energy within its orb before blasting a target with electrifying force.
This heavy tome is used as a repository of knowledge as well as an implement for spellcraft. In the hands of an arcane practitioner, it can project concussive blasts of force towards a target.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a Critical Success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Recognize Spellcraft.name: Recognize Spellcraft
Recognize Spellcraft.description: You can interpret the arcane incantations of others to discern the nature of their spellcraft. When an enemy within 40 feet that you can see and hear begins casting a spell, you can identify its Rune if you also know that Rune.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale. In special circumstances it may be used to inflict Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.

Evoke.name: Evoke
Evoke.description:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Frost.name: Rune: Frost
Rune: Frost.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.

Condense.name: Condense
Condense.description:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Create.name: Gesture: Create
Gesture: Create.description:
You coalesce arcane power into tangible form, manifesting a Sprite which appears within 10 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Sprite is a Minion of half your own Level.

The Create gesture scales with Wisdom and the Sprite survives for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Sprite; casting another spell using the Create gesture replaces your previous Sprite. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

Not all Runes have a Sprite actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Creation will — for now — manifest a@UUID[Compendium.crucible.summons.Actor.RuNh1bFGiHKdHeKI].

Provocateur.name: Provocateur
Provocateur.description: You specialize in barbed repartee crafted to highlight your opponent's shortcomings. In combat you can launch quips which provoke your foes.

Scathing Mockery.name: Scathing Mockery
Scathing Mockery.condition: Your target can hear and understand you.
Scathing Mockery.description:
You exaggerate your opponent's shortcomings with a scathing bon mot, improvising a Performance skill attack against your target's Willpower. On a success they suffer modest Psychic damage to Morale.

On a Critical Success, they also become @Condition[enraged] for 1 Round.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the Focus cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Action cost by 1 in exchange.

Inflection: Push.name: Inflection: Push
Inflection: Push.description: Empower a spell to repel affected creatures away from the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Push inflection are forcibly moved a distance away from the spellcaster equal to the Ability Bonus that applied to the Spell, potentially colliding with walls or other movement-blocking obstacles.

Orbiting Aegis.name: Orbiting Aegis
Orbiting Aegis.description: You can set your implement wheeling about you of its own accord, turning aside blows that would otherwise land.

Orbiting Aegis.name: Orbiting Aegis
Orbiting Aegis.description:
You set your Talisman into a defensive orbit which persists until you dismiss it. While the Aegis turns and you have a Talisman equipped, you gain a bonus to your Block defense equal to your current Focus, to a maximum of +3. Each time the Aegis turns a blow aside you spend 1 Focus.

Dismiss the Aegis by removing its effect.

Conjurer.name: Conjurer
Conjurer.description: You are a master of using the Gestures of Conjuration and Creation to manifest arcane energy as physical form. You can maintain up to 3 such creations simultaneously rather than only one.

Arcing Bolt.name: Arcing Bolt
Arcing Bolt.description: Your bolt does not stop where it lands. Loosed with a practiced flick, it springs onward to a second foe standing close by.

Arcing Bolt.name: Arcing Bolt
Arcing Bolt.description: You perform a Talisman attack against a single target. The bolt then arcs to the nearest other enemy within 10 feet of your target which has line of sight to it, striking that foe for reduced damage. The second target is chosen automatically.

Channeler's Grip.name: Channeler's Grip
Channeler's Grip.description: Your hold upon your implement is so assured that a single hand suffices for workings which ought to demand two. While wielding a one-handed Talisman you may cast spells which require two hands, no matter what occupies your other hand.

Telekinetic.name: Telekinetic
Telekinetic.description:
You wield kinetic force with practiced ease, bending the paths of objects and creatures to your will.

  • Once per turn, when you apply @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionpush00]{Inflection: Push} or @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionpull00]{Inflection: Pull} to a Spell, you ignore the inflection's Focus cost.

  • You double the distance at which you can Pull, Flick, or Suspend using the @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeKinesis00000 propel] action.

  • You unlock the Telekinetic Flight action, suspending yourself aloft to fly and hover.

Telekinetic Flight.name: Telekinetic Flight
Telekinetic Flight.description: You suspend yourself aloft on currents of kinetic force, gaining the @Condition[flying] condition to fly and hover. You sustain the effect with Focus each round; it ends if you become @Condition[incapacitated].

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using Presence, targets Physical defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.

Propel.name: Propel
Propel.description:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Sentinel Bolts.name: Sentinel Bolts
Sentinel Bolts.description: You set a ring of waiting motes wheeling slowly about you. They keep their own watch, and they strike without being told.

Sentinel Bolts.name: Sentinel Bolts
Sentinel Bolts.description:
You surround yourself with an aura of attendant motes which is Maintained at a cost of 1 Focus per turn. Any enemy which enters the aura or ends its turn within it suffers a Talisman attack.

Playtest Notes

The aura is placed and maintained, but its attacks against enemies who enter or end their turn within it are not yet automated.

Gesture: Conjure.name: Gesture: Conjure
Gesture: Conjure.description:
You coalesce arcane power into a superior form, manifesting a Visitor which appears within 30 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Visitor is a Minion equal to your own Level.

The Conjure gesture scales with Wisdom and the Visitor survives for 12 Rounds. You may only have one active Visitor. Casting another spell using the Conjure gesture replaces your previous Visitor. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Not all Runes have a Visitor actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Conjuration will — for now — manifest a@UUID[Compendium.crucible.summons.Actor.AlwoqQKoL1BnnZjd].

Inexorable Flame.name: Inexorable Flame
Inexorable Flame.description: You recognize that fire can spread with inevitable and unstoppable purpose. Your usage of the Rune of Flame scales with Wisdom instead of Intellect.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.

Enkindle.name: Enkindle
Enkindle.description:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rimecaller.name: Rimecaller
Rimecaller.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Frost. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your Critical Hits which deal damage cause the @Condition[freezing] condition.

The Freezing effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half the ability score your Rune of Frost scales with as Frost damage to Health, and applies the @Condition[slowed] condition.

description.public: This mage staff is a talisman to assist with spellcraft or hurl blasts of frigid ice towards enemies.
A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.

A small, vibrant blue pearl that feels refreshingly cool to the touch regardless of ambient temperature.

This enchanted pearl grants its bearer the Replenish Focus action, providing an additional reserve of Focus that can be drawn upon in moments of duress.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Pearl with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.focusing00000000]{Focusing} prefix.

This affix can be applied to any accessory and this pearl could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 suffix.
