Focusing.description: Grants the Replenish Focus action, allowing the bearer to restore Focus in moments of duress. The amount restored scales with the Tier of this affix.

affixFocusing.name: Replenish Focus
affixFocusing.description:
In moments of duress you can withdraw an additional reserve of Focus from this item. The amount of Focus restored depends on the Tier of this prefix.

  • Tier 1: 4 Focus

  • Tier 2: 6 Focus

  • Tier 3: 8 Focus

description.public:
This steel ring feels permanently cool to the touch and gives the sensation of weighing more than expected given its narrow band.

This enchanted ring provides a bonus to Armor defense.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.reinforcement000]{Reinforcement} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Reinforcement.name: Reinforcement
Reinforcement.description: Increase Armor defense by 1 for each Tier of this suffix.

description.public: A surprisingly thin liquid that tastes earthy and herbal.

Omniglot Decoction.name: Omniglot Decoction
Omniglot Decoction.description:
When consumed, this decoction affords the drinker the fascinating ability to read, speak, and comprehend languages. Its quality determines the duration of the effect:

  • Shoddy - 10 minutes

  • Standard - 1 hour

  • Fine - 4 hours

  • Superior - 12 hours

  • Masterwork - 24 hours

description.public: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually fortify the psyche and improve morale.

Rallying Tonic.name: Rallying Tonic
Rallying Tonic.description:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Morale dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Morale each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Morale each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Morale each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Morale each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Morale each Round

description.public: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Assess Resolve.name: Assess Resolve
Assess Resolve.description:
You take a moment to observe a creature which you can see and develop intuition about whether its body or its spirit is the more resilient.

Perform a Knowledge Test using the appropriate Skill for the creature. On a success, you learn whether the creature has greater maximum Health or greater maximum Morale. On a Critical Success the Gamemaster additionally describes how the creature is likely to behave should it become @Condition[broken].

Assess Resolve.name: Assess Resolve
Assess Resolve.description: You observe a creature you can see to judge whether its body or its spirit is the more resilient.

ancestry.name: Gnome
ancestry.description: Yours was a birth of exuberant celebration. Your diminutive body and delicate features are paired with an almost supernatural propensity for discovery. The traditions of your people embrace a lust for life and the importance of quick-thinking and quick-action.

background.name: Acolyte
background.description: You were a person of faith. You learned how to live selflessly in service to others or in pursuit of a higher ideal.

Replenish Focus.name: Replenish Focus
Replenish Focus.description:
In moments of duress you can withdraw an additional reserve of Focus from this item. The amount of Focus restored depends on the Tier of this prefix.

  • Tier 1: 4 Focus

  • Tier 2: 6 Focus

  • Tier 3: 8 Focus

Reconstruct.name: Reconstruct
Reconstruct.description:
Name aloud a theory of what happened in this place. If the Gamemaster judges that the place could bear your theory out or contradict it, perform an Awareness check against DC 14.

  • +2 Boons if your theory follows from evidence you have already gathered.

  • +2 Banes if it is conjecture, or if the place has been cleaned, trampled, or reoccupied since.

Upon a Success you deduce one true thing bearing upon your theory, which may support or refute it. Upon a Critical Success you deduce a second, which the Gamemaster may draw from what your theory did not think to ask.

A theory may only be investigated once. A failed investigation does not mean the theory is incorrect, only that no corroborating evidence was found.

The place answers in physical fact alone: it never names a culprit, a motive, or a word that was spoken.

Frostdrop Phial.name: Frostdrop Phial
Frostdrop Phial.description:
You throw the @ref[item.name], dealing weakened Cold damage to all enemies in the radius of the explosion who fail to avoid the attack and causing them to be @Condition[slowed] briefly. The radius of the Blast depends on the quality of the bomb:

  • Shoddy - 3 feet

  • Standard - 4 feet

  • Fine - 6 feet

  • Superior - 8 feet

  • Masterwork - 10 feet

Gliding.name: Gliding
Gliding.description:
If used while @Condition[falling], you may laterally move a number of spaces from your initial location as you glide. The gliding distance depends on the Tier of this prefix.

  • Tier 1: 1 foot per 20 feet of descent.

  • Tier 2: 2 feet per 20 feet of descent.

  • Tier 3: 4 feet per 20 feet of descent.

You take no falling damage upon landing, nor are you rendered @Condition[prone].

Grapple.name: Grapple
Grapple.description: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform an Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.

Hamstring.name: Hamstring
Hamstring.description: You make Strike attack which is @Rule[action.difficult], but if successful, inflicts the @Condition[slowed] condition for 3 Rounds.

Headbutt.name: Headbutt
Headbutt.description:
Make an unarmed Strike against the Fortitude defense of an adjacent enemy. If your Initiative is superior to that of your target, you gain +1 Boon to this attack.

The attack is @Rule[action.difficult] and only deals @Rule[action.weakened] damage, but if successful it inflicts the @Condition[staggered] for 1 Round.

This action always uses an Unarmed weapon, even if your weapon slots are otherwise occupied.

Font of Life.name: Font of Life
Font of Life.description:
You bring forth an aura of life-giving magic. Immediately upon activation and at the start of your turn for 3 Rounds every ally within 20 feet heals for an amount equal to your Wisdom score.

WIP: This action is currently treated as an Area of Effect, granting healing-over-time effects to those within the initial range. When auras are automated by the system in Foundry VTT version 14, the mechanical implementation of this action will match the description.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.description:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Hearthwork.name: Hearthwork
Hearthwork.condition: You have a Cook's Toolkit equipped.
Hearthwork.description:
Food carries the history of what was done to it. With a Cook's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by cooking which you can clearly see within 30 feet, learning its Quality tier, whether it has spoiled, and what has been added to it. When you eat something prepared by another hand, you learn its recipe.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously spoil non-magical food or drink which you can physically touch, turning a dish, a cask, or a company's rations rancid beyond salvage. Alternatively, in the course of preparing food or drink yourself, you may sabotage it while leaving it looking and smelling wholesome. You name the condition under which it fails; when that condition is met, the Gamemaster decides the consequences. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional Awareness check which beats your passive Cooking.

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to ingredients, you may prepare any food or drink you are familiar with and have it come out as you intended, from field porridge to a wedding cake to a cordial you tasted once in another country. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully prepare any dish outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Heavy Strike.name: Heavy Strike
Heavy Strike.description: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is @Rule[action.empowered] to deliver additional damage.

Inspire Heroism.name: Inspire Heroism
Inspire Heroism.description: Each ally, excluding yourself, within 10 feet gains +1 Boon to actions performed until the end of their next turn.

Interrupting Throw.name: Interrupting Throw
Interrupting Throw.condition: An enemy you can see casts a Spell which costs 3 Action or greater.
Interrupting Throw.description: When an enemy that you can see casts a Spell which costs 3 Action or greater, as a @Rule[action.reaction] you can perform a Thrown weapon attack against the caster. If your attack results in a Critical Hit the spell is interrupted and its magic is lost.

Intimidate.name: Intimidate
Intimidate.description: You physically intimidate an enemy that is within your engagement range, performing an Intimidation Skill attack against your target's passive Intimidation defense. On a success, they sustain Void damage to their Morale.

Intuit Weakness.name: Intuit Weakness
Intuit Weakness.description: You still your mind and study the physiology of your foe, attempting to identify a vulnerability in its defenses.

biography.public: Kagura is a stalwart healer who bolsters the health and morale of her allies amidst the frenzy of battle. Kagura aspires to obtain the Healer signature Talent.

description.public: Overlapping metal plates sewn or riveted onto a leather or cloth backing, scale mail resembles the hide of a dragon and protects well against cuts and stabs—though it's noisy and inflexible.

Rune: Life.name: Rune: Life
Rune: Life.description:
A chaotic force of creation, responsible for living matter. The Life rune governs health and matters relating to biological growth.

The Life rune scales using Wisdom and provides Restoration of Health. In special circumstances it may be used to inflict Poison damage opposed by Fortitude. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Death.

Bloom.name: Bloom
Bloom.description:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description:
Your sharpened mind is full of secrets and techniques to remember them. Once per day you may focus your thoughts and attempt to recall a word that sparks your memory.

The Gamemaster must provide you with a one-word clue that is appropriate for your direction of inquiry. It is left to Gamemaster's discretion how direct or vague to be with the clue they provide.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description: You survey your memories attempting to recall a clue for your current situation.

Precision Shot.name: Precision Shot
Precision Shot.description: You take time to steady your aim and target the weakest point of a foe. You may only get one shot, but you make it count.

Precision Shot.name: Precision Shot
Precision Shot.description: You steady your aim and fire a single @Rule[action.accurate] shot.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Wildspeaker.name: Wildspeaker
Wildspeaker.description: You have a preternatural knack for communicating with animals. Through body language and sounds, you are capable of interpreting and communicating in the language of the wilderness.

Wildspeak.name: Wildspeak
Wildspeak.description:
If you succeed on a [[/skillCheck wilderness 14]] check, you may pose simple questions to a Beast which can perceive you. As long as the creature is not hostile it will respond accurately within the limits of its own knowledge.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score of zero are incapable of understanding you.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score of 1 can only respond with "yes" or "no" responses.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score greater than 1 can provide simple multi-word responses.

description.public: This talisman, favored by druidic adherants attuned to the power of the land, aids in the practice of spellcraft or can be used in combat to direct a gout of poisonous spores towards an enemy.

Hearthwork.name: Hearthwork
Hearthwork.description: You are the one who makes sure everyone has eaten. A hot bowl pressed into the hands of a companion at the end of a bad day is the whole of your craft, and you have never let one go to sleep hungry.

Hearthwork.name: Hearthwork
Hearthwork.condition: You have a Cook's Toolkit equipped.
Hearthwork.description:
Food carries the history of what was done to it. With a Cook's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by cooking which you can clearly see within 30 feet, learning its Quality tier, whether it has spoiled, and what has been added to it. When you eat something prepared by another hand, you learn its recipe.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously spoil non-magical food or drink which you can physically touch, turning a dish, a cask, or a company's rations rancid beyond salvage. Alternatively, in the course of preparing food or drink yourself, you may sabotage it while leaving it looking and smelling wholesome. You name the condition under which it fails; when that condition is met, the Gamemaster decides the consequences. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional Awareness check which beats your passive Cooking.

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to ingredients, you may prepare any food or drink you are familiar with and have it come out as you intended, from field porridge to a wedding cake to a cordial you tasted once in another country. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully prepare any dish outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Mender.name: Mender
Mender.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Life. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your Critical Hits which restore Health cause the @Condition[mending] condition.

The Mending effect lasts for 1 Round and deals the ability score your Rune of Life scales with as additional Restoration to Health.

Healer.name: Healer
Healer.description: You are unparalleled at manipulating vital arcana to treat injuries. You learn Rune: Life if you do not already know it. When healing allies using the Rune of Life you gain +2 Boons to your roll.

Font of Life.name: Font of Life
Font of Life.description:
You bring forth an aura of life-giving magic. Immediately upon activation and at the start of your turn for 3 Rounds every ally within 20 feet heals for an amount equal to your Wisdom score.

WIP: This action is currently treated as an Area of Effect, granting healing-over-time effects to those within the initial range. When auras are automated by the system in Foundry VTT version 14, the mechanical implementation of this action will match the description.

Shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
Shapeshifter.description:
You possess supernatural ability to transform your body into the shapes of beasts.

You undergo a transformation where you assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with and which is half your level or less. While transformed you have the exact attributes and abilities of the chosen beast.

Your equipment is magically incorporated into the form that you take, however you gain no benefit from that equipment while transformed.

If your bestial form becomes @Condition[incapacitated] you revert back to your normal form with any excess damage becoming Wounds. If your Morale is @Condition[broken] while in beast form your transformation ends and any excess damage becomes Madness.

Playtest Notes

This talent and its associated actions are not yet automated.

Beast Shape.name: Beast Shape
Beast Shape.description: You assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with of one-half your level or less.

Revert Shape.name: Revert Shape
Revert Shape.description: You end your bestial transformation, returning to your normal form.

Wild Strike.name: Wild Strike
Wild Strike.description: You have a developed familiarity with using features of your own body as natural weapons including claws, jaws, tails, or other mechanisms of self-defense.

Wild Strike.name: Wild Strike
Wild Strike.description: Immediately after you perform a basic @Action[default strike], you perform a reduced-cost follow-up Strike against the same target using a different Natural weapon that you have access to.

Unarmed Blocking.name: Unarmed Blocking
Unarmed Blocking.description: Through long practice and toughened resolve you are able to block enemy blows using your bare limbs. While Unarmed or wielding only Natural weapons, half your Toughness score contributes to your Block defense.

Feral Brawler.name: Feral Brawler
Feral Brawler.description:
You fight with your bare hands the way a beast fights with claw and jaw, committing to a savagery that trained fighters are taught out of.

Your bare hands count as Natural weapons in addition to Unarmed ones. You may use them for any action which requires a Natural weapon, and they are wielded using whichever of your Natural or Unarmed proficiencies serves you better.

Thick Skin.name: Thick Skin
Thick Skin.description: Your physical toughness makes you more resistant to harm. You gain +2 Resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

Lesser Regeneration.name: Lesser Regeneration
Lesser Regeneration.description: Your prodigious hardiness conveys a supernatural capability to recover from wounds quickly. At the start of your turn if you are not @Condition[weakened] you gain +1 Health.

Battle-Worn.name: Battle-Worn
Battle-Worn.description: Your body has endured so many injuries that it has learned how to mend itself with remarkable efficiency. When you perform the @Action[default rest] action, you recover additional Wounds equal to half your Toughness score (rounded down).

Slow Simmer.name: Slow Simmer
Slow Simmer.description:
You keep the fire and the pot, and you have the ingenuity to cook meals in circumstances that are far from ideal.

A meal you prepare lasts 16 hours rather than 8. Those who eat it recover an additional amount of Wounds and Madness equal to half your Wisdom when the @Action[default rest] concludes. You may prepare a meal wherever the party is able to Rest at all, without fire or shelter.

Playtest Notes

Meals are not yet implemented. This talent describes how the Cooking trade will behave once meal preparation is a Rest activity.

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Wisdom, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.

Motivate.name: Motivate
Motivate.description:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the Focus cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Action cost by 1 in exchange.

Gesture: Surge.name: Gesture: Surge
Gesture: Surge.description:
You channel the arcane power of a Rune into a rushing wave of energy that surges forward from your current position.

The Surge gesture scales with Wisdom and produces a line that is 10 feet wide and 15 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale. In special circumstances it may be used to inflict Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.

Evoke.name: Evoke
Evoke.description:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Undaunted.name: Undaunted
Undaunted.description: Despair takes your voice and your courage, but never your command of the arcane. You may continue to spend Focus even while you are @Condition[broken].

description.public:
This brightly colored necklace holds a stone amulet that glows with a rune that crackles faintly with electrical resonance. While holding it you have the surreal sensation of the world around you slowing down ever so slightly.

This enchanted amulet provides a bonus to Reflex defense.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Amulet with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.nimbleness000000]{Nimbleness} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this amulet could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Nimbleness.name: Nimbleness
Nimbleness.description: Increase Reflex defense by 1 for each Tier of this suffix.

description.public:
This charm-covered necklace looks rustic, but upon close inspection you notice a delicate craft imbued within its workmanship. While holding it you feel your breaths deepen and the minor aches within your muscles dissipate.

This enchanted charm provides a bonus to Fortitude defense.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Charm with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.tenacity00000000]{Tenacity} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this charm could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Tenacity.name: Tenacity
Tenacity.description: Increase Fortitude defense by 1 per each Tier of this suffix.

description.public: A particularly cruel and sharp mechanical trap designed to immobilize and kill the unwary. A saw-toothed steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center

Arm Steel-Jaw Trap.name: Arm Steel-Jaw Trap
Arm Steel-Jaw Trap.description: Setting the trap places a dangerous hazard that deals significant damage if triggered. It must be affixed by heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or spike driven into the ground. The area of the trap is a circle with a radius of 2 feet.

Trigger Steel-Jaw Trap.name: Trigger Steel-Jaw Trap
Trigger Steel-Jaw Trap.description:
When triggered the creature that set the trap makes a Wilderness skill attack against the Reflex defense of a single target which triggered the trap. If not resisted, it deals piercing damage and applies the @Condition[restrained] condition. The base damage dealt by the trap varies according to the quality of the trap.

  • Shoddy - 1 damage

  • Standard - 2 damage

  • Fine - 4 damage

  • Superior - 8 damage

  • Masterwork - 16 damage

description.public: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

description.public: Overlapping metal plates sewn or riveted onto a leather or cloth backing, scale mail resembles the hide of a dragon and protects well against cuts and stabs—though it's noisy and inflexible.

ancestry.name: Giantkin
ancestry.description: Elemental forces presided over your birth, instilling you with supernatural vigor. Your large frame and muscular build often lead others to believe you are an unthinking mass of muscle, but yours is a people known most for their physical resilience and the deep well of their knowledge. You have inherited the strength of mountains.

background.name: Physician
background.description: You were a healer or medical professional of some variety. You have spent a portion of your life learning medical science, and you have a propensity for noticing illness in others. You know how to treat wounds, diseases, and how to identify their sources.

Last Stand.name: Last Stand
Last Stand.description: You expend Heroism to instantly recover two times your Toughness in Health. Your Healing Threshold is reduced by 2 for the next 3 Rounds.

Activate Illumination.name: Activate Illumination
Activate Illumination.description:
You speak the command word and the @ref[item.name]{item} kindles into a steady otherworldly glow. The radius of bright light shed depends on the Tier of this prefix, with an additional radius of dim light extending an equal distance beyond.

  • Tier 1: 20 feet of bright light, 40 feet of dim light.

  • Tier 2: 40 feet of bright light, 80 feet of dim light.

  • Tier 3: 60 feet of bright light, 120 feet of dim light.

The light persists until you dismiss the effect or remove the item.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.description:
You dart forward nimbly, attacking with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a weapon which scales using Dexterity against a single target, with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is @Rule[action.difficult], but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke a @Action[default reactiveStrike].

Mark Prey.name: Mark Prey
Mark Prey.description: You Strike using a special shot. If your attack is successful the target is @Condition[exposed] for the next 3 Rounds.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description: You survey your memories attempting to recall a clue for your current situation.

Omniglot Decoction.name: Omniglot Decoction
Omniglot Decoction.description:
When consumed, this decoction affords the drinker the fascinating ability to read, speak, and comprehend languages. Its quality determines the duration of the effect:

  • Shoddy - 10 minutes

  • Standard - 1 hour

  • Fine - 4 hours

  • Superior - 12 hours

  • Masterwork - 24 hours

Orbiting Aegis.name: Orbiting Aegis
Orbiting Aegis.description:
You set your Talisman into a defensive orbit which persists until you dismiss it. While the Aegis turns and you have a Talisman equipped, you gain a bonus to your Block defense equal to your current Focus, to a maximum of +3. Each time the Aegis turns a blow aside you spend 1 Focus.

Dismiss the Aegis by removing its effect.

Precision Shot.name: Precision Shot
Precision Shot.description: You steady your aim and fire a single @Rule[action.accurate] shot.

Scathing Mockery.name: Scathing Mockery
Scathing Mockery.condition: Your target can hear and understand you.
Scathing Mockery.description:
You exaggerate your opponent's shortcomings with a scathing bon mot, improvising a Performance skill attack against your target's Willpower. On a success they suffer modest Psychic damage to Morale.

On a Critical Success, they also become @Condition[enraged] for 1 Round.

Quick Draw.name: Quick Draw
Quick Draw.description: You can loose a shot under pressure, although with decreased accuracy. You perform a Strike that is @Rule[action.difficult], but has a reduced Action cost.

Quickening.name: Quickening
Quickening.condition: You have an Enchanter's Toolkit equipped.
Quickening.description:
With an Enchanter's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You need only touch an item to know whether it is enchanted, whether or not it belongs to you. Handling it at length tells you which affixes it bears and how much of its capacity remains unspent.

  • Destroy. You touch an object bearing a minor enchantment which still waits upon its condition, whether your own work or another enchanter's, and unmake it. The object itself is unharmed. Alternatively you may conceal an item's enchantment for 10 minutes, so that it reads as mundane to anyone whose passive Enchanting does not exceed your own, though it loses nothing of its power.

  • Create. You imbue a Rune you know into an object no larger than a foot in any dimension, empowering it to perform one simple task under a condition you name. The enchantment lasts until the object has performed that task once, or until 24 hours have passed.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry
Rallying Cry.description: You produce a courageous bellow that inspires allies within 12 feet of you to remain stalwart in the face of peril. You make an Intimidation check against the Rallying Threshold of each ally. Upon a success, they become @Condition[resolute] for 3 Rounds. Upon a Critical Success, they also recover an amount of Morale equal to your Presence score.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

Rallying Tonic.name: Rallying Tonic
Rallying Tonic.description:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Morale dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Morale each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Morale each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Morale each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Morale each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Morale each Round

Rapid Countermeasure.name: Rapid Countermeasure
Rapid Countermeasure.condition: You must have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped in your Toolbelt.
Rapid Countermeasure.description:
You smother, douse, neutralize, or earth an elemental reaction afflicting an ally you can touch. Remove one instance of @Condition[burning], @Condition[freezing], @Condition[corroding], or @Condition[shocked] from the target.

The reagents are drawn from your Toolkit and are not otherwise tracked.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a Critical Success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Motivate.name: Motivate
Motivate.description:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Mould.name: Mould
Mould.description:
Your command of the Rune of Earth allows you to manipulate raw forces of rock, mineral, and soil in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Quickly shape up to one cubic foot of available material into a simple geometric form like a cuboid, ellipsoid, or polyhedron.

  • Precisely copy the physical shape of a held object that is smaller than a 6-inch cube, reproducing it from available clay, stone, or metal. The replica retains no useful properties except for its physical form.

  • Separate and collect earthen particles from the surface of an object, creature, or liquid that you touch, rendering the subject completely cleaned or purified in moments.

Mould may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Enkindle.name: Enkindle
Enkindle.description:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Condense.name: Condense
Condense.description:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Propel.name: Propel
Propel.description:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Bloom.name: Bloom
Bloom.description:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Evoke.description:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Energize.name: Energize
Energize.description:
Your command of the Rune of Storm allows you to conduct the flow of both air and electricity, manipulating charge and aerodynamics to produce one of the following effects:

  • Instill an electromagnetic charge into a metallic object that you touch no larger than a one-foot cube, causing it to strongly adhere to other metals. Only one object can be charged in this way at a given time, casting this spell on a different object causes the prior object to lose its magnetic effect.

  • Gather a squall of wind at your current location in a six-foot radius which blows either as a gust in a single controlled direction or as a cyclone with centripetal force in all directions. Airborne effects in the immediate area are dispersed and unsecured objects with weight less than 1 are flung in the direction of the gust.

  • Produce the concussive sound of a thunderclap at a location you can see within 15 feet of your current position.

Energize may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Ruthless Momentum.name: Ruthless Momentum
Ruthless Momentum.condition: You incapacitate an enemy with a melee attack.
Ruthless Momentum.description: After defeating an enemy, you immediately move up to your Stride and Strike another foe that you pass next to or end your movement adjacent to.

Sentinel Bolts.name: Sentinel Bolts
Sentinel Bolts.description:
You surround yourself with an aura of attendant motes which is Maintained at a cost of 1 Focus per turn. Any enemy which enters the aura or ends its turn within it suffers a Talisman attack.

Playtest Notes

The aura is placed and maintained, but its attacks against enemies who enter or end their turn within it are not yet automated.

Beast Shape.name: Beast Shape
Beast Shape.description: You assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with of one-half your level or less.

Revert Shape.name: Revert Shape
Revert Shape.description: You end your bestial transformation, returning to your normal form.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: Following a basic @Action[default strike] with your mainhand weapon, you Strike with your shield, causing the @Condition[staggered] condition for 1 Round.

Sneak.name: Sneak
Sneak.description: Target one enemy which you can see at a distance of at least 20 feet. You make a Stealth check against their Awareness. Upon a success that creature loses track of you until the start of your next turn, or until you perform an action targeting them which is not @Rule[action.subtle]. Upon a Critical Success the effect instead persists for 2 Rounds.

Arm Steel-Jaw Trap.description: Setting the trap places a dangerous hazard that deals significant damage if triggered. It must be affixed by heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or spike driven into the ground. The area of the trap is a circle with a radius of 2 feet.

Trigger Steel-Jaw Trap.description:
When triggered the creature that set the trap makes a Wilderness skill attack against the Reflex defense of a single target which triggered the trap. If not resisted, it deals piercing damage and applies the @Condition[restrained] condition. The base damage dealt by the trap varies according to the quality of the trap.

  • Shoddy - 1 damage

  • Standard - 2 damage

  • Fine - 4 damage

  • Superior - 8 damage

  • Masterwork - 16 damage

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike
Sundering Strike.description: You make a Strike with a Strength-scaling weapon which, if successful, applies the @Condition[exposed] condition to your target for 3 Rounds. This attack is @Rule[action.difficult] to perform and deals @Rule[action.weakened] damage.

Swipe.name: Swipe
Swipe.description: You perform a Strike against two adjacent enemies, attacking both of them using a single swing of your great weapon.

Telekinetic Flight.name: Telekinetic Flight
Telekinetic Flight.description: You suspend yourself aloft on currents of kinetic force, gaining the @Condition[flying] condition to fly and hover. You sustain the effect with Focus each round; it ends if you become @Condition[incapacitated].

Thread the Needle.name: Thread the Needle
Thread the Needle.description: You fire a precise shot into melee combat, targeting an enemy which is engaged by one of your allies.

Tumble.name: Tumble
Tumble.description:
Make a Athletics Skill attack against an adjacent enemy contested by your target's Reflex defense.

On a success you may move up to twice your Stride, including the ability to pass through your target enemy's space, without provoking any @Action[default reactiveStrike].

On a failure your movement is blocked and your remain in your current position.

biography.public: Ulfen is a fierce warrior who fights with a two-handed greataxe, favoring heavy blows that do significant damage or hit multiple targets. Ulfen aspires to obtain the Berserker signature talent.

description.public: Overlapping metal plates sewn or riveted onto a leather or cloth backing, scale mail resembles the hide of a dragon and protects well against cuts and stabs—though it's noisy and inflexible.
A towering weapon with a broad, often double-bladed head, the greataxe is made for delivering devastating cleaves, hewing men and beasts with terrible force.

Grapple.name: Grapple
Grapple.description: You are familiar with basic martial arts and hand-to-hand combat. You know how to subdue or restrain opponents using your physical strength.

Grapple.name: Grapple
Grapple.description: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform an Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description:
Your sharpened mind is full of secrets and techniques to remember them. Once per day you may focus your thoughts and attempt to recall a word that sparks your memory.

The Gamemaster must provide you with a one-word clue that is appropriate for your direction of inquiry. It is left to Gamemaster's discretion how direct or vague to be with the clue they provide.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description: You survey your memories attempting to recall a clue for your current situation.

Hamstring.name: Hamstring
Hamstring.description: You use a slashing weapon to target the legs of an enemy and cripple their movement.

Hamstring.name: Hamstring
Hamstring.description: You make Strike attack which is @Rule[action.difficult], but if successful, inflicts the @Condition[slowed] condition for 3 Rounds.

Swipe.name: Swipe
Swipe.description: You perform a broad swipe with your weapon, hitting two adjacent targets within your weapon range.

Swipe.name: Swipe
Swipe.description: You perform a Strike against two adjacent enemies, attacking both of them using a single swing of your great weapon.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: This martial technique is a specialized two-handed fighting maneuver which relies upon brute strength to swing your weapon in a wide arc, hitting multiple enemies in its path.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: A ferocious two-handed swing cleaves through foes in a 120 degree arc.

Bull Rush.name: Bull Rush
Bull Rush.description: You can use your physical prowess to push past opponents who block your path.

Bull Rush.name: Bull Rush
Bull Rush.description: Make an Athletics Skill attack against an adjacent enemy contested by your target's Fortitude defense. On a success you may move up to your Stride directly through the enemy's space. Your enemy is knocked @Condition[prone] and may not make any @Action[default reactiveStrike] against you. On a failure your movement is blocked and your remain in your current position.

Powerful Physique.name: Powerful Physique
Powerful Physique.description: You can wield weapons with the Slow trait and wear Armor with the Bulky trait without suffering Banes to your Initiative rolls.

Ferocious Leap.name: Ferocious Leap
Ferocious Leap.description: You leap powerfully into battle to deliver a punishing blow to a nearby enemy with your mainhand weapon.

Ferocious Leap.name: Ferocious Leap
Ferocious Leap.description: You Jump up to 10 feet, delivering a Strike against an enemy within melee range of where you land. Your movement ignores difficult terrain and is not blocked by enemy creatures.

Brutal Display.name: Brutal Display
Brutal Display.description: You go beyond simply defeating your enemies, you make an example of them. When you slay a foe, every enemy within 20 feet who can see their @Condition[dead] ally suffers damage to their Morale equal to your Strength score.

Battle-Worn.name: Battle-Worn
Battle-Worn.description: Your body has endured so many injuries that it has learned how to mend itself with remarkable efficiency. When you perform the @Action[default rest] action, you recover additional Wounds equal to half your Toughness score (rounded down).

Last Stand.name: Last Stand
Last Stand.description: You can muster the toughness and courage to fight on and stand your ground against improbable odds.

Last Stand.name: Last Stand
Last Stand.description: You expend Heroism to instantly recover two times your Toughness in Health. Your Healing Threshold is reduced by 2 for the next 3 Rounds.

Thick Skin.name: Thick Skin
Thick Skin.description: Your physical toughness makes you more resistant to harm. You gain +2 Resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description:
You revel in the thrill of combat, hurling yourself into the fray with reckless abandon.

While @Condition[enraged] you may still spend Focus on any action which is not a spell.

Berserker Rage.name: Berserker Rage
Berserker Rage.condition: You have suffered damage to your Health pool since your last turn in Combat.
Berserker Rage.description:
You become @Condition[enraged]. While Enraged you deal 4 additional damage on all melee attacks. You may attempt to end the effect on your own turn by succeeding on a Willpower test against a DC of 20. The effect ends automatically when Combat is concluded.

Playtest Notes

The aforementioned "Willpower test" is legacy terminology. The mechanism for ending Berserker Rage on yourself is not currently determined or automated.

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike
Sundering Strike.description: You know a martial technique to exploit the weakest points of an enemy's defenses, exposing them to further harm.

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike
Sundering Strike.description: You make a Strike with a Strength-scaling weapon which, if successful, applies the @Condition[exposed] condition to your target for 3 Rounds. This attack is @Rule[action.difficult] to perform and deals @Rule[action.weakened] damage.

Blood Frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
Blood Frenzy.description: Your battle lust spurs you to feats of heightened action. When you achieve a Critical Hit that deals damage to Health you immediately gain +1 Action. This benefit may only happen once per Round.

Executioner's Strike.name: Executioner's Strike
Executioner's Strike.description: You deliver a single decisive strike against a wounded enemy.

Executioner's Strike.name: Executioner's Strike
Executioner's Strike.description: You deliver a Strike with a two-handed weapon. If your attack is successful and your opponent is under half their maximum Health, the strike is @Rule[action.deadly], and the opponent suffers the @Condition[bleeding] condition for 3 Rounds, taking additional damage each round equal to your Strength score.

Spellmute.name: Spellmute
Spellmute.description:
Currents of magic flow strangely around you, as if unaware of your presence.

You cannot perform any action with the Spell tag. Spells which target you suffer +2 Banes regardless of whether they impose harmful or beneficial effects.

Headbutt.name: Headbutt
Headbutt.description: You can deliver a brutal close-range strike with your head that catches opponents off-guard.

Headbutt.name: Headbutt
Headbutt.description:
Make an unarmed Strike against the Fortitude defense of an adjacent enemy. If your Initiative is superior to that of your target, you gain +1 Boon to this attack.

The attack is @Rule[action.difficult] and only deals @Rule[action.weakened] damage, but if successful it inflicts the @Condition[staggered] for 1 Round.

This action always uses an Unarmed weapon, even if your weapon slots are otherwise occupied.

Iron Resolve.name: Iron Resolve
Iron Resolve.description: Your physical resilience makes you too tough to be deeply affected by a powerful blow. The Critical Success threshold for Strikes against you is increased by +1, making you harder to critically hit.

Adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
Adrenaline.description: Pain sharpens your concentration. Once per round, when you sustain Health damage from an attack, you gain +1 Focus.

Sentinel.name: Sentinel
Sentinel.description: You punish those who try to slip past your guard. When you damage an enemy with a @Action[default reactiveStrike], that creature becomes @Condition[slowed] until the end of its next turn.

description.public: Corrosive liquid swirls within this vial of intentionally thin glass, designed to shatter on impact and spill the caustic substance upon a target.

Caustic Phial.name: Caustic Phial
Caustic Phial.description:
You fling the @ref[item.name], dealing @Rule[action.weakened] immediate Acid damage but causing the @Condition[corroding] condition to all enemies in a 4 foot radius Blast who fail to avoid the attack.

The amount of corroding damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[item.name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 2 rounds

  • Standard - 3 damage for 3 rounds

  • Fine - 4 damage for 4 rounds

  • Superior - 6 damage for 5 rounds

  • Masterwork - 8 damage for 6 rounds

description.public: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

description.public: A slender phial that contains a slightly golden-colored liquid. It smells foul, but contains the alchemical agents necessary to neutralize a wide variety of toxins.

Antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
Antitoxin.description:
Consuming this @ref[item.name] is able to neutralize any @Condition[poisoned] conditions affecting the target. Stronger poisons require a stronger antitoxin to neutralize.

The category of poison negated by this @ref[item.name] depends on its quality:

  • Shoddy - Poisons dealing 3 damage or less per round

  • Standard - Poisons dealing 5 damage or less per round

  • Fine - Poisons dealing 7 damage or less per round

  • Superior - Poisons dealing 9 damage or less per round

  • Masterwork - Poisons dealing 11 damage or less per round

description.public:
This steel ring feels permanently cool to the touch and gives the sensation of weighing more than expected given its narrow band.

This enchanted ring provides a bonus to Armor defense.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.reinforcement000]{Reinforcement} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Reinforcement.name: Reinforcement
Reinforcement.description: Increase Armor defense by 1 for each Tier of this suffix.

description.public:
This elegant ornamented ring feels slightly slick and difficult to grasp. While held it vibrates almost imperceptibly.

This enchanted ring provides a bonus to Dodge defense.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.evasion000000000]{Evasion} suffix.

This affix can be applied to any armor or accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 prefix.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: Increase Dodge defense by 1 for each Tier of this suffix.

description.public: Overlapping metal plates sewn or riveted onto a leather or cloth backing, scale mail resembles the hide of a dragon and protects well against cuts and stabs—though it's noisy and inflexible.
A towering weapon with a broad, often double-bladed head, the greataxe is made for delivering devastating cleaves, hewing men and beasts with terrible force.

ancestry.name: Human
ancestry.description: Found amid countless conditions and far-flung places, you were born an ever-adaptable human. Tall or short, thin, muscular, or rotund, your physical appearance is nothing if not varied. Humans are most known for a genetic predisposition toward determination, with traditions that drive a stubborn will to survive.

background.name: Constable
background.description: You were part of a law enforcement organization. You learned how to remain vigilant to your surroundings, work within complex social structures, and affect an imposing presence.

Uppercut.name: Uppercut
Uppercut.description: Following a basic @Action[default strike] which did not Critically Miss, you Strike the same target again with the backswing of your weapon at reduced Action cost.

Volatile Accelerant.name: Volatile Accelerant
Volatile Accelerant.condition: You must have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped in your Toolbelt.
Volatile Accelerant.description:
You throw a measure of oil, powdered metal, or biting salts onto an enemy already suffering @Condition[burning], @Condition[freezing], @Condition[corroding], or @Condition[shocked], performing a Science skill attack against their Fortitude defense.

Upon a success they sustain damage of the same type, and to the same resource, as the reaction you fed, and its remaining duration is extended by 1 Round. Upon a Critical Success the reaction also burns hotter, increasing the damage it deals each round by 1.

Playtest Notes

This action is intended to consume a unit of alchemical reagent from your inventory, offering an alternative use for the same ingredients you would otherwise craft with. That requirement is not yet implemented and awaits the design of the crafting system.

Wild Strike.name: Wild Strike
Wild Strike.description: Immediately after you perform a basic @Action[default strike], you perform a reduced-cost follow-up Strike against the same target using a different Natural weapon that you have access to.

Wildspeak.name: Wildspeak
Wildspeak.description:
If you succeed on a [[/skillCheck wilderness 14]] check, you may pose simple questions to a Beast which can perceive you. As long as the creature is not hostile it will respond accurately within the limits of its own knowledge.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score of zero are incapable of understanding you.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score of 1 can only respond with "yes" or "no" responses.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score greater than 1 can provide simple multi-word responses.

Wortcunning.name: Wortcunning
Wortcunning.condition: You have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped.
Wortcunning.description:
Every preparation leaves its signature. With an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by alchemy which you can handle, learning its Quality tier, what it will do, and whether it has degraded past use. From residue alone, a stain, a shattered flask, a scorch on stone, you identify what was prepared there if you know its recipe.

  • Destroy. You spend 10 minutes to spoil a non-magical item created by alchemy which you can physically touch, leaving a potion inert and a bomb a dud. Alternatively, in the course of preparing such a work yourself, you may leave it appearing sound while ensuring it does nothing at all when next relied upon. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional Awareness check which beats your passive Alchemy.

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to ingredients, you may prepare any minor alchemical work you are familiar with: inks and dyes, a glue that holds under water, a perfume that lingers a full day, fireworks in three colors, acid enough to etch a name in steel. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully prepare any such work outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

biography.public: Zarajah is a spirited Devilkin with a penchant for pyromancy who weaves dangerous and warding spells to control the battlefield. Zarajah aspires to obtain the War Mage signature Talent.

description.public: This mage staff is a talisman to assist with spellcraft or hurl gouts of arcane flame at enemies.
Ring mail features metal rings sewn onto a padded base, offering a compromise of less protection than heavier mail options in exchange for greater mobility.

Camaraderie.name: Camaraderie
Camaraderie.description: You know how soldiers and travellers of a dozen peoples take their ease: which stories are told, which songs are sung, which silences are kept. Time spent in your company settles the mind.

Camaraderie.name: Camaraderie
Camaraderie.description: Following a @Action[default rest], you find the common ground you share with each of your companions. You make a Society check against the Rallying Threshold of each member of your party. Upon a success they shed Madness equal to half your Wisdom, or your full Wisdom upon a Critical Success.

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using Presence, targets Physical defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.

Propel.name: Propel
Propel.description:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Diversionist.name: Diversionist
Diversionist.description: You specialize in using subterfuge to distract or trick your opponent during combat.

Distract.name: Distract
Distract.description: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a Critical Success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.

Enkindle.name: Enkindle
Enkindle.description:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

description.public: This mage staff is a talisman to assist with spellcraft or hurl gouts of arcane flame at enemies.
Ring mail features metal rings sewn onto a padded base, offering a compromise of less protection than heavier mail options in exchange for greater mobility.

Opportunistic Spellcraft.name: Opportunistic Spellcraft
Opportunistic Spellcraft.description: Your quick thinking can weave magic to exploit brief windows of opportunity. You may make a @Action[default reactiveStrike] using the Touch Gesture instead of a melee weapon attack.

Opportunist.name: Opportunist
Opportunist.description: You seize any opportunity you can to capitalize on an enemy who turns their back on you. You may make a @Action[default reactiveStrike] even if you are otherwise Fully Engaged.

Intuit Weakness.name: Intuit Weakness
Intuit Weakness.description:
You calm your mind and study the physiology of your foe, seeking a vulnerability in its defenses.

Perform a Knowledge Test using the appropriate Skill for the creature. On a success, you learn the Damage type that the creature has the greatest Vulnerability towards, if any. On a Critical Success you learn the two Damage types which have the largest vulnerability.

Intuit Weakness.name: Intuit Weakness
Intuit Weakness.description: You still your mind and study the physiology of your foe, attempting to identify a vulnerability in its defenses.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.condition: Another creature which you can see is casting a spell.
Counterspell.description:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Spell attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Inflection: Quicken.name: Inflection: Quicken
Inflection: Quicken.description: Enhance a spell by hastening the speed with which it can be cast, at the expense of increased Focus. The Quicken inflection reduces the Action cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Focus cost by 1 in exchange.

Pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
Pyromancer.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Flame. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your Critical Hits which deal damage cause the @Condition[burning] condition.

The Burning effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals half the ability score your Rune of Flame scales with as Fire damage to both Health and Morale.

Sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
Sorcerer.description:
Your magic is deeply instinctual and your practice of spellcraft defies traditional academic understanding.

You cannot cast Iconic Spells, but when you cast a spell using an Inflection it deals an additional +1 Damage per Iconic Spell Slot that you have.

Piercing Bolts.name: Piercing Bolts
Piercing Bolts.description: You have learned to shape your bolts to a needle point which slips between wards and scales alike. Your Talisman attacks ignore 2 points of the target's Resistance.

Quickening.name: Quickening
Quickening.description: Years of binding have taught your hands to feel magic through leather and steel. Whether a glyph was freshly set or has long since sunk into the grain, you know that it is there.

Quickening.name: Quickening
Quickening.condition: You have an Enchanter's Toolkit equipped.
Quickening.description:
With an Enchanter's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You need only touch an item to know whether it is enchanted, whether or not it belongs to you. Handling it at length tells you which affixes it bears and how much of its capacity remains unspent.

  • Destroy. You touch an object bearing a minor enchantment which still waits upon its condition, whether your own work or another enchanter's, and unmake it. The object itself is unharmed. Alternatively you may conceal an item's enchantment for 10 minutes, so that it reads as mundane to anyone whose passive Enchanting does not exceed your own, though it loses nothing of its power.

  • Create. You imbue a Rune you know into an object no larger than a foot in any dimension, empowering it to perform one simple task under a condition you name. The enchantment lasts until the object has performed that task once, or until 24 hours have passed.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the Focus cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Action cost by 1 in exchange.

Inflection: Push.name: Inflection: Push
Inflection: Push.description: Empower a spell to repel affected creatures away from the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Push inflection are forcibly moved a distance away from the spellcaster equal to the Ability Bonus that applied to the Spell, potentially colliding with walls or other movement-blocking obstacles.

Certain Focus.name: Certain Focus
Certain Focus.description: Drawing your reserves back into yourself has become as reliable as breathing. Your @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.refocus000000000]{Refocus} action can no longer fail, though it may still critically succeed.

Kineturge.name: Kineturge
Kineturge.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Kinesis. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your Critical Hits which deal damage cause the @Condition[bleeding] condition.

The Bleeding effect lasts for 1 Round and deals the ability score your Rune of Kinesis scales with as additional Piercing damage to Health.

Gesture: Pulse.name: Gesture: Pulse
Gesture: Pulse.description:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with a 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Blast.name: Gesture: Blast
Gesture: Blast.description:
You hurl the arcane power of a Rune into an intense explosion of energy at a nearby point you can see.

The Blast gesture scales with Intellect and produces a blast with a 6 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the spellcaster. The blast deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

description.public:
This carefully faceted gemstone glows faintly with warm light, and feels warm to the touch.

This enchanted gem grants its bearer the Activate Illumination action, shedding an otherworldly light in a wide radius until dismissed.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Gem with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.luminous00000000]{Luminous} prefix.

This affix can be applied to any accessory and this gem could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 suffix.

Luminous.name: Luminous
Luminous.description: Grants the Activate Illumination action, allowing the bearer to shed an otherworldly light. The radius of light scales with the Tier of this affix.

affixLuminous.name: Activate Illumination
affixLuminous.description:
You speak the command word and the @ref[item.name]{item} kindles into a steady otherworldly glow. The radius of bright light shed depends on the Tier of this prefix, with an additional radius of dim light extending an equal distance beyond.

  • Tier 1: 20 feet of bright light, 40 feet of dim light.

  • Tier 2: 40 feet of bright light, 80 feet of dim light.

  • Tier 3: 60 feet of bright light, 120 feet of dim light.

The light persists until you dismiss the effect or remove the item.

description.public:
This ring made of an opaque stone that has been carefully carved with graceful, sweeping layers evoking an ancient aesthetic. The ring serves as a powerful spellcasting focus for the Invested wearer.

This enchanted ring grants the ability to withdraw an additional reserve of Focus in moments of duress.
description.private:
This item is presented as an example of a Fine Ring with the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.affixes.ActiveEffect.focusing00000000]{Reserved Focus} prefix.

This affix can be applied to any accessory and this ring could be further enchanted with a Tier 1 suffix.

Focusing.name: Focusing
Focusing.description: Grants the Replenish Focus action, allowing the bearer to restore Focus in moments of duress. The amount restored scales with the Tier of this affix.

affixFocusing.name: Replenish Focus
affixFocusing.description:
In moments of duress you can withdraw an additional reserve of Focus from this item. The amount of Focus restored depends on the Tier of this prefix.

  • Tier 1: 4 Focus

  • Tier 2: 6 Focus

  • Tier 3: 8 Focus

description.public: A suspension of white crystal inside a blue liquid contained within a sealed glass container. Its contents rapidly evaporate when exposed to air, creating a small blast of freezing liquid that coats nearby matter in an icy film.
description.private: Primarily used to rapidly cool metallurgical compounds in advanced smithing, these alchemical phials can be quite dangerous to living tissue if exposed for a long period of time.

Frostdrop Phial.name: Frostdrop Phial
Frostdrop Phial.description:
You throw the @ref[item.name], dealing weakened Cold damage to all enemies in the radius of the explosion who fail to avoid the attack and causing them to be @Condition[slowed] briefly. The radius of the Blast depends on the quality of the bomb:

  • Shoddy - 3 feet

  • Standard - 4 feet

  • Fine - 6 feet

  • Superior - 8 feet

  • Masterwork - 10 feet

description.public: A flammable concoction that ignites upon impact and burns intensely for a short time.

Alchemist's Fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
Alchemist's Fire.description:
You hurl the @ref[item.name], dealing @Rule[action.weakened] immediate Fire damage but causing the @Condition[burning] condition to all enemies in a 4 foot radius Blast who fail to avoid the attack.

The amount of burning damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[item.name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 2 rounds

  • Standard - 3 damage for 3 rounds

  • Fine - 4 damage for 4 rounds

  • Superior - 6 damage for 5 rounds

  • Masterwork - 8 damage for 6 rounds

description.public: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.description:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

ancestry.name: Devilkin
ancestry.description: You were born with unexpected magical influence over your creation. Your physical appearance shows tell-tale signs that the superstitious associate with planar beings- crimson flesh, ineffective wings or horns, reptilian eyes. Your dislike of light and preternatural resistance to fire does little to dissuade people from thinking you are an actual devil.

background.name: Performer
background.description: You were a travelling entertainer. You learned to be comfortable attending a variety of social functions, how to play to your audience, embellishing details of your performance to evoke particular emotional responses.
